zh-CN.name: 完成前强制验证
zh-CN.shortDesc: 没有新鲜验证证据，不得声称完成或通过。需能运行项目的测试与构建命令。

en-US.name: Verification Before Completion
en-US.shortDesc: No claiming a task is done or passing without fresh verification evidence. Needs the ability to run the project's tests and build commands.
